data.text: Erik's direction: a calm dashboard of all MY insurance (personal assistant, not B2B). Agents find better deals and negotiate in parallel by REAL phone calls (GPT-Live) and email (AgentMail). Tap into any live agent to see transcript + everything it knows. Demo: several team members get called at once by agents, we watch/listen live.
Each negotiation runs as its own Fly.io Machine (same image, worker entrypoint), state shared via Neon docs table; dashboard streams updates over SSE.

data.spec: Neon table docs(collection,id,data jsonb,updated_at). Call = lib/types.ts Call {id, policyId, status dialing|live|ended, channel browser|phone|email, target, machineId, counterpart, theirOffer, ask, agreedMonthly, citing[], transcript Turn[]}. Write via lib/store.ts store.putCall.

data.title: B2 Daylight dashboard (design/b2-*.html): state per policy, live agent rows, policy page, live call page — Erik's session

Put shared keys in .env (never commit): OPENAI_API_KEY, EXA_API_KEY, KERNEL_API_KEY, AGENTMAIL_API_KEY, DATABASE_URL (Neon), NEON_AI_GATEWAY_URL, NEON_AI_GATEWAY_KEY, FLY_API_TOKEN, TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_NUMBER. Post in team chat which ones exist.
